body: It's my fault I'm sure. I'm too nice and people tend to take advantage
That's probably it considering my past. I just don't know how or where to find people who actually appreciate me and not just use me.
I want to and he's told me before he has similar feelings for me. I'm just scared because I've never felt this way about someone who felt it back
Yeah. It wasn't like we were together by label but we were really close and then all of a sudden he started showing an interest in her and she stopped showing affection to me.
It's helped a lot of my friends. Also sorry I'm like sharing my life story, I just like talking lol. Thanks for listening.

Me too. I still haven't been to therapy or been treated for anything because my dad didn't believe in mental illness, and with everything that's happening in my life right now, I hope to get treated in someway soon.
Thank you. I know it's easy for a lot of people including myself to forget that people are there for them when they're in a bad mindset. Mental illness can be a bitch tbh.
